in_marathi.name: Sharvraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Sharvraj is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu deity Indra, the king of gods. The name signifies the power and dominion of the divine ruler.

vedic_reference.note: The name Sharvraj is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Sharva' (Lord of the mountains) and 'Raj' (King). It is a compound name that signifies 'Lord of the Sharp Weapon' or 'King of Sharp Weapon'. This name is not directly referenced in any Vedic scripture or mythology.
